research.outcome: Answer a bounded question from current, attributable evidence.

skills.name: research
skills.when: General primary-source research with a repository brief.

skills.name: social-research
skills.when: Understanding videos/reels/social sources.

skills.name: notes-index
skills.when: The question concerns prior local work or decisions.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.when: The question concerns OpenAI/Codex products or setup.

inputs: Exact question, original sources, freshness needs and intended decision.
steps: Choose the appropriate source route.
Inspect original passages, contradictory evidence and access gaps.
Return the answer with direct sources and limitations.
research.check: Every material claim matches inspected evidence; inaccessible is distinct from absent.
research.stop: Bounded question answered or exact missing source prevents it.
research.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

interface.outcome: Design or improve an interface under its owning identity.

skills.name: design-system-workflow
skills.when: Any app/site interface or design-system task.

skills.name: rahil-design
skills.when: Rahil's own public project, personal website or explainer.

skills.name: web-designer-pro
skills.when: A full website build; do not pair with art-director by default.

skills.name: app-designer-pro
skills.when: Native/mobile application design.

skills.name: art-director
skills.when: A single page/section needs art direction.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.when: Focused existing-interface UX polish or refinement.

skills.name: design-qa-checklist
skills.when: Implementation needs design-to-build QA.

inputs: User task, states, platform and current project identity/instructions.
steps: Read owning DESIGN.md and global design routing when present.
Choose one lead design skill; use other skills only for a concrete gap.
Exercise empty, loading, error and success states at real use sizes.
interface.check: Inspect actual implementation and task behavior, accessibility and responsive states.
interface.stop: Requested interface is reviewed with platform limits stated; rendered drafts retain design gates.
interface.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

figure.outcome: Explain one defensible finding in a truthful, legible figure.

skills.name: present-data
skills.when: Choosing form and checking the reader, point and container.

skills.name: rahil-design
skills.when: Rahil's own public visual.

skills.name: research-exhibit
skills.when: Producing a Rahil Bhavan Research exhibit with Proof Desk.

skills.name: tufte-graphics
skills.when: Quantitative integrity, form and ink.

skills.name: dataviz
skills.when: Colour, contrast, labeling and interaction.

skills.name: anatomy
skills.when: An interactive physical-object mechanism explanation is appropriate.

skills.name: explainer
skills.when: The task is to teach or explain the mechanism.

inputs: Original data/source definitions, one finding, audience, format and design owner.
steps: State the finding before selecting a form.
Use the owning renderer and record numbers' receipts.
Inspect exact export at full and feed size with its surrounding copy.
figure.check: Check factual fidelity, numerical integrity, actual-size legibility and applicable design receipts.
figure.stop: Checked artifact returned; outstanding required review leaves design review pending.
figure.boundary: Drafting/rendering does not authorize publication. Client and private-app identities retain authority.

video.outcome: Produce a locally rendered video with a clear purpose.

skills.name: motion-director
skills.when: A video starts from an idea without real product assets.

skills.name: launchr
skills.when: A launch/demo uses actual logos, screenshots or product photos.

skills.name: rahil-design
skills.when: Personal-brand media.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.when: An AI-generated bitmap is needed and requested scope supports it.

inputs: Message, audience, real assets when applicable, duration and owning identity.
steps: Choose motion-director or launchr from the actual inputs.
Render locally and inspect playback, sound and readability.
Return the MP4 and actual checks.
video.check: Watch the exact export and inspect real-size text, timing and audio.
video.stop: Requested draft meets brief or missing assets prevent it.
video.boundary: No publishing, store submission or asset rights inferred from local availability.

presentation.outcome: Build a clear, source-grounded presentation that survives real viewing.

skills.name: presentation-craft
skills.when: Storyline, exhibits, notes and substantive craft.

skills.name: consulting-slides
skills.when: Rahil Workshop Slides is the requested identity.

skills.name: present-data
skills.when: Numbers, tables or figures are presented.

skills.name: presentations
skills.when: Authoring an editable presentation artifact; resolve the managed entry ID.

inputs: Audience, decision/learning objective, time, original evidence and reference deck.
steps: Choose the storyline and owning design system.
Use the correct authoring skill for native Google Slides or deck files.
Render/inspect slides, sources and speaker notes.
presentation.check: Check claim fidelity, editable exhibits, layout, contrast and presentation-size legibility.
presentation.stop: Requested deck and actual render checks delivered; native-platform limits remain visible.
presentation.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

steps: Select the account owner before drafting.
Follow production's bounded copy/visual review.
Return exact packet, receipts and remaining holds.

weekly-content.outcome: Prepare the explicitly requested weekly content batch.

skills.name: x-weekly-pack
skills.when: The coming week's personal X pack was requested.

skills.name: x-post-production
skills.when: Production and package review stages.

skills.name: x-growth
skills.when: Personal account facts and metrics.

skills.name: grokbot-handoff
skills.when: User explicitly asks to deliver checked packages to the Mac Bot.

skills.name: cross-host-control
skills.when: The authorized work spans box and Mac.

inputs: Current accepted schedule, dated sources, account identity and active package contract.
steps: Read current schedule decisions rather than assuming an old cadence.
Prepare slots under the weekly workflow and shared production limits.
Hand off only through the separately authorized delivery workflow.
weekly-content.check: Exact package/schedule identities, source agreement and required design receipts.
weekly-content.stop: Requested batch or authorized handoff completes; report missing Bot/provider/platform evidence.
weekly-content.boundary: No recurring schedule, activation or publication implied.
